lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Grabe 'yang Drafting Plate at Calculus problem set mo, {name}! Puno ng eraser crumbs buong sahig — pero ang linis ng drawing mo ah!
lines.textEn: Whoa, look at that Drafting Plate and Calculus set, {name}! Floor covered in eraser dust — yet those lines are razor sharp!

choices.text: Tapusin ang plate at mag-offer ng Math tutoring sa freshies! (Play Tutoring Quiz)
choices.textEn: Finish the plate and tutor freshmen in Calculus! (Play Tutoring Quiz)
